test_examples_run_all: run the pytest test that executes all mujoco_py example scripts found in the examples directory
test_examples_skip_mjvive: run the test_examples function which skips any example script containing mjvive in its path
test_examples_with_testing_env: run the test_examples function that sets the TESTING environment variable to true before executing scripts
review_test_examples_function: review the test_examples pytest function that discovers and runs all python scripts in the mujoco_py examples folder
summarize_test_examples: summarize the test_examples function which uses subprocess to run each discovered example script sequentially
